items.title: Marshall Lawrence Interview, 1960-06-28
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] It may have been Phillips Fisher or something. [INTERVIEWEE] No, I remember George Trish.

ctx.x: George something. It may have been Phillips Fisher or something.
No, I remember George Trish. Oh, I see. That boy Herbert played with us there. That's his daddy. He used to play in the honors band.
